title: Lumen Studio: seat transfer for a new hire
transcript:
Agent: Lumen support, this is Grace. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Grace, this is Hana from Lumen Studio. One of our designers left last week, and we want to move her seat to a new hire who starts Monday.
Agent: I can help with that. Can you confirm the account ID and the email address on the departing user's seat?
Customer: Account 6621. The departing user is Mira Chen, mchen at lumen studio dot com. The new hire is Alex Rivera, arivera at lumen studio dot com.
Agent: I see Mira's seat. Before I transfer it, can you confirm that you are an account admin?
Customer: Yes, I am the admin on the account.
Agent: Thank you. I am going to remove Mira's access and reassign the seat to Alex. Mira's files will stay in the workspace, but her login will be deactivated. Do you want Alex to inherit the same permissions?
Customer: Yes, the same designer permissions. She should not have admin access.
Agent: Understood. I have transferred the seat and kept the designer role. Alex will get an invitation email with a temporary password. The invitation expires in 48 hours.
Customer: Great. Will Mira's old projects show up for Alex?
Agent: Yes, the projects stay in the shared workspace. Alex will see them when she logs in. I will mark the ticket as resolved and send you a confirmation.
Customer: Perfect. Thank you.
Agent: You are welcome. Have a good day.
